infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: PainterApp needs camera access to capture photos of areas you want to measure.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: PainterApp tags each photo with the GPS coordinates where it was captured.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: PainterApp may save measured photos to your library.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow PainterApp to access your camera to capture areas to measure.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow PainterApp to tag photos with the GPS coordinates where they were taken.
